title: Lost Shtreimel Returned
body: A Brooklyn man, Zeus, found a lost shtreimel and tracked down its Chassidishe owner, returning it in an emotional meeting, documented in videos.

title: Missing Chareidi Teenager
body: A 19-year-old chareidi young man from central Israel is missing after being last seen near the Yarkon Stream. Authorities are searching for him, fearing he may have been swept out to sea.
